title: OCaml Temporal native client visibility count request
description: Closed JSON document used only by the private Rust client bridge, submitted with the COUNT client call selector (#1152). Runtime validators also reject duplicate keys, NUL bytes, and strings over the 65,536-byte safety limit; maxLength is the character-count bound expressible in standard JSON Schema.

query.description: Temporal visibility query; the empty string counts every execution.

rpc_timeout_ms.description: Optional caller deadline in milliseconds. Omitted means 10 seconds.
